source: FROZEN REGRESSION FIXTURE - profiles/filaments.json exactly as it shipped through Phases 1 and 2, before the printer was ever asked what it was holding. Four of these five slots disagreed with the AMS on 2026-08-02 (spike S16) and slicer.ams_mapping converted that into a confidently wrong slot with no error: PETG resolved to slot 2, which held purple PLA, and ABS to slot 3, which held green PETG. It is frozen deliberately - the live file has been corrected, and pointing the regression at the live file would mean this drift stops being tested the moment somebody fixes it.
